entry.title: Fallout 4 Forge

update.note: Download the new source zip, extract it over the checkout folder and run START-HERE.bat; the forge home, tools folder and workspace are kept.

entry.notes: Fallout 4 mods: plugins (Spriggit YAML + Mutagen worker), Papyrus, F4SE native, BA2, textures, materials, meshes, audio, MCM, RobCo Patcher, Base Object Swapper, packaging and deploy.
